MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only

   D. Primary consumers only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen

   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
